sn22.55:1.3: I follow the interpretation established by Bhikkhu Bodhi, for which see his note 75 on this discourse in *Connected Discourses*.
sn22.55:8.9: “Will vanish” is _vibhavissati_, literally “will cease to be”. It’s used throughout [snp4.11]() and, in a meditation context, in [an11.9:7.1](). At [iti49:7.3]() it refers to the ending of continued existence for an arahant.
sn22.55:9.4: Here the monk quotes the Buddha, as indicated by the close _-ti_ in the text.
